scope: Windows 11 development host. Synthetic projects, separate desktop identity, loopback model. No production profile or authenticated cloud endpoint.

regression.before: Four delayed Auto plans executed after switching the foreground with a project pinned. The project session key did not change. Auto was also available from an unrelated surface.
frontendCases: Same folder in a second tab
Other folder in the same tab
Same-folder refresh retains Auto; unrelated surface cannot enable it
nativeSteps: Pin project A and select Auto; delay a create plan until folder B is active. No new file in A or B before confirmation.
Return to A; verify Confirm remains selected, approve the original plan, and read the expected file from A only.
Select shared.md in A, allow one model read of the A copy, then move to B and back before the edit proposal arrives. Inspect the diff and approve; the B copy remains unchanged.
Leave pinned mode, return to B and recover its independent prompt. Exactly three loopback requests (one creation turn plus read/answer for the edit).

nativeSuitesPassed: M3 WebView2 selection (separate opt-in native test)
validation.binaryDelivery: Verified every source file against the manifest after extraction, compiled the x64 release offline from the extracted tree using a shared Cargo target cache, compared the packaged EXE byte-for-byte to that build, verified the Windows ZIP inventory and the engine manifest pin.
